title: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements in Output Used by a Downstream Component ('Injection') vulnerability in…
description: A medium severity injection vulnerability (CWE-74) exists in the Wikimedia Foundation MediaWiki WikiLambda Extension, specifically in the file includes/Special/SpecialPreviewAbstract.php. It involves improper neutralization of special elements in output used by a downstream component. No affected versions or patch information are provided.
